description: Dawnstone, Duskstone and their polished blocks, stairs and slabs on a white platform in the sky, plus 7x4 walls of Dawnstone and Duskstone to show whether their textures tile without seams.
steps: execute in minecraft:overworld run forceload add 0 0 15 15
execute in minecraft:overworld run fill 0 200 2 15 200 12 minecraft:white_concrete
execute in minecraft:overworld run setblock 0 201 10 chronodawn:dawnstone
execute in minecraft:overworld run setblock 2 201 10 chronodawn:polished_dawnstone
execute in minecraft:overworld run setblock 4 201 10 chronodawn:polished_dawnstone_stairs
execute in minecraft:overworld run setblock 6 201 10 chronodawn:polished_dawnstone_slab
execute in minecraft:overworld run setblock 8 201 10 chronodawn:duskstone
execute in minecraft:overworld run setblock 10 201 10 chronodawn:polished_duskstone
execute in minecraft:overworld run setblock 12 201 10 chronodawn:polished_duskstone_stairs
execute in minecraft:overworld run setblock 14 201 10 chronodawn:polished_duskstone_slab
execute in minecraft:overworld run fill 0 201 4 6 204 4 chronodawn:dawnstone
execute in minecraft:overworld run fill 8 201 4 14 204 4 chronodawn:duskstone

steps.command: execute in minecraft:overworld if block 2 201 10 chronodawn:polished_dawnstone
execute in minecraft:overworld if block 10 201 10 chronodawn:polished_duskstone

steps.note: Front row, left to right: Dawnstone, Polished Dawnstone, its stairs and slab, Duskstone, Polished Duskstone, its stairs and slab. Behind them a Dawnstone wall (left) and a Duskstone wall (right). The polished blocks have a framed face by design. No magenta-black missing textures, stairs and slabs have the right shape.
Close-up of the 7x4 Dawnstone wall: the texture repeats without visible seams or lines between blocks.
Close-up of the 7x4 Duskstone wall: the texture repeats without visible seams or lines between blocks.

steps: execute in minecraft:overworld run forceload remove 0 0 15 15
